issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (PipelineStepper.jsx:21). Caused by Emergent dev-tooling injecting x-source-editable wrapper spans inside computed <option> text. Harmless in prod, pollutes dev console. Same issue flagged in iteration_68.

critical_code_review_comments: legal_lens._assert_finalizable is asymmetric: it enforces pathway_rationale iff conflict_pathways is set, but doesn't require professional_summary or court_summary_text — a professional could finalize with only a signature_name and produce a nearly-empty PDF. Consider mandating a minimum body (professional_summary or court_summary_text) before allowing status=final.

LegalLensReport.jsx line 123: pdf URL is built from window origin (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) plus /api/... — works, but hard-codes /api prefix in JSX instead of reusing the api client. If the API prefix ever changes, this breaks silently. Move to a helper (e.g., api.getUri).
PipelineStepper option rendering triggers hydration warning (see design_issues) — wrap computed option text so no injected span appears inside <option>.
